Outokumpu Oyj Appoints New Chief Operating Officer Amid Strategic Growth Initiatives

Outokumpu Oyj, Finland’s leading stainless steel producer, has announced the appointment of Sanna Leinonen as its new Chief Operating Officer (COO), effective August 1, 2024. The move is part of the company’s ongoing strategy to streamline operations and reinforce its position in the European steel market.

Leinonen, who most recently served as Executive Vice President of operations at Nordic Metals Group, brings more than 20 years of experience in industrial management. She will report directly to Heikki Malinen, Outokumpu Oyj’s President and CEO. Leinonen succeeds Jari Mäkinen, who is retiring following a decade with the company.

Heikki Malinen said in a statement, “We are delighted to welcome Sanna to Outokumpu’s executive team. Her extensive operational expertise and strong leadership track record will be invaluable as we continue to optimize our production footprint and advance our sustainability agenda.”

The appointment comes as Outokumpu Oyj pursues a series of modernization projects at its Tornio and Kemi works, aimed at increasing output efficiency and reducing carbon emissions. Analysts have noted that the company’s recent investments in electric arc furnace technology and digitalization reflect a broader push within the European steel sector for greener and more resilient manufacturing processes.

Commenting on her new role, Sanna Leinonen stated, “I am honoured to join Outokumpu at such a pivotal time. Together with the team, I look forward to supporting our operational excellence initiatives and ensuring we deliver value to our customers and stakeholders.”

Industry observers welcomed the appointment, citing Leinonen’s reputation for driving operational improvements and successful integration of digital tools. Markku Virtanen, senior analyst at the Finnish Steel Federation, remarked, “Outokumpu’s decision signals its commitment to both technological leadership and operational stability. Sanna Leinonen’s background in process optimization makes her a strong fit for the company’s ambitions.”

Outokumpu Oyj employs over 9,000 people globally, with its headquarters in Helsinki. The company reported net sales of EUR 8.2 billion in 2023 and continues to be a key supplier of stainless steel for sectors ranging from construction and automotive to energy and consumer goods.

The company has indicated there are no changes to its current strategic priorities or long-term financial guidance as a result of the appointment. Outokumpu Oyj’s next financial update is scheduled for late July, prior to Leinonen’s formal onboarding.
